name: ragger-ai
description: Ragger.ai — Knowledge Engineering & RAG Creation Platform

scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build --workspace=@ragger/desktop && npm run start --workspace=@ragger/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:integration && npm run test:frozen && npm run test:pack && npm run test:installer && npm run test:clean
scripts.pack:desktop: npm run build && npm run bundle:engine && npm run pack --workspace=@ragger/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run bundle:engine && npm run dist --workspace=@ragger/desktop
